Text:
[II] Let us give unending thanks to Christ, our head and teacher. He came as a servant to do good among and for us all. Therefore, with humble confidence, we ask Him:
[IR] Lord, visit your family.
[I1] Be present, Lord, with the leaders of your Church, who share with you the work as head, teacher, and shepherd,
[I2] that, through You, they may lead us all to the Father.
[I1] May Your Spirit and angels accompany them on their journey
[I2] and preserve them from what ensnares our bodies and souls.
[I1] Teach us, by Your example, to serve one another,
[I2] just as You came to serve and not to be served.
[I1] Knit us more tightly together as one expansive family where each is helped by another,
[I2] that with Your presence, we will be like a strong city.
[I1] Be merciful to all those who have died,
[I2] receiving them into the light of Your presence.
Changes: 2025-04-11 - Paul Prins: Initial translation of these intentions.
